description: Cancel a UCP checkout session: pass checkout_id. A completed session cannot be canceled, and canceling one that is already canceled changes nothing. Needs a Last Price credential with price compute scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

checkout_id.description: The checkout session: its id, as create_ucp_checkout and list_ucp_checkouts show it.

name: cancel_ucp_checkout
